metadata.name: divstrip
metadata.description: Dividend strip: split xStocks into PT (capital) and YT (yield)

instructions.name: create_series
docs: Create PT/YT mints for a single yield nonce (coupon step `nonce → nonce+1`).
`yield_nonce` may be the tip or a forward nonce within `max_forward_nonces`.

instructions.name: deposit_curve_yt_for_shares
docs: Deposit curve-YT into vault; mint lcYT shares at NAV (ERC-4626 style).

instructions.name: donate_curve_yt_to_vault
docs: Donate curve-YT to vault without minting shares — raises NAV for remaining lcYT.

instructions.name: init_curve_bridge
docs: Link strip series to Meteora curve-YT mint and create curve-YT vault ATAs.

instructions.name: on_report
docs: CRE path (optional / unused by xstocks-ca-sync): emit `YtLaunchRequested`
for a single yield nonce. Desk initializes Meteora DBC→DAMM directly.

instructions.name: redeem_shares_for_curve_yt
docs: Burn lcYT shares; withdraw proportional curve-YT (NAV redeem).

instructions.name: register_curve_launch
docs: Market authority registers the canonical Meteora pool after policy launch.

instructions.name: request_curve_launch
docs: Permissionless: request canonical curve-YT pool deployment for one yield nonce.
Emits `YtLaunchRequested` for CRE log-trigger / launcher workflows.

instructions.name: swap_curve_yt_for_strip_yt
docs: Deposit curve-YT; receive strip YT (`strip_amount >= min_strip_out`).

instructions.name: swap_strip_yt_for_curve_yt
docs: Deposit strip YT; receive curve-YT at client-quoted DAMM spot (`curve_amount >= min_curve_out`).

instructions.name: unwrap
docs: Burn equal PT + YT; return underlying 1:1.

instructions.name: wrap
docs: Escrow underlying and mint PT + YT 1:1 for the series nonce.
Allowed while tip is still at or before the series yield nonce (spot or forward).

errors.name: InvalidForwardNonces
errors.msg: max_forward_nonces must be greater than zero

errors.name: RegistryMintMismatch
errors.msg: registry mint does not match strip underlying

errors.name: NonceNotMature
errors.msg: yield nonce has not matured yet

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: YieldNonceNotFound
errors.msg: yield nonce not found in registry

errors.name: BridgeMintMismatch
errors.msg: curve-YT mint does not match vault

errors.name: InsufficientStripYt
errors.msg: curve-YT vault has insufficient strip YT

errors.name: LaunchAlreadyRegistered
errors.msg: curve-YT launch already registered for this series

errors.name: UnauthorizedRegistrar
errors.msg: registrar must be strip market authority

errors.name: LaunchNotRegistered
errors.msg: canonical curve-YT launch not registered for this series

types.name: CurveWindowLaunch
docs: Canonical Meteora curve-YT pool registered for a strip series (single nonce).

types.name: CurveYtBridge
docs: Curve-YT vault: links a strip series to its Meteora curve-YT mint.

types.name: LaunchYtReport
docs: CRE WriteReport payload: request curve-YT launch for a single yield nonce.

fields.name: max_forward_nonces
docs: Max nonces ahead of tip that users may open (e.g. tip=3 → open up to 3+8).

types.name: StripSeries
docs: One strip series per dividend yield nonce (covers coupon step `nonce → nonce+1`).

fields.name: bump
docs: Frozen at series creation from registry (0 for forward nonces until redeem).

types.name: YtLaunchRequested
docs: Keeps LaunchYtReport in the Anchor IDL for CRE WriteReportFromLaunchYtReport.
